translations.web: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool, that he may become wise.
translations.bsb: Let no one deceive himself. If any of you thinks he is wise in this age, he should become a fool, so that he may become wise.
translations.kjv: Let ➔ no man deceive himself. If any man among you seemeth to be wise in this world, let him become a fool, that he may be wise.
translations.asv: Let no man deceive himself. If any man thinketh that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool, that he may become wise.
